research_scope: Absolute Zero, Dragon Burn, Dimensional Hole, and Counter Burst acquisition/taxonomy audit.

findings.name: Absolute Zero
findings.finding: Retained. The available reward transcription confirms Absolute Zero is associated with PQ96, but does not establish an Ultimate Finish-only reward slot.

findings.name: Dragon Burn
findings.finding: Retained. The available reward transcription confirms Dragon Burn is associated with PQ82; no explicit UF-only classification was found in the reviewed source.

findings.name: Dimensional Hole
findings.acquisition: PQ80 — The Return of the Giant Ape-Fest
findings.finding: Retained. The available reward transcription confirms Dimensional Hole as a PQ80 skill reward, consistent with the repository's Basic Reward evidence.

findings.name: Counter Burst
findings.finding: Retained. The available reward transcription confirms Counter Burst as the PQ75 skill reward, consistent with the repository's Basic Reward evidence.

source_note: The independently indexed Steam PQ reward transcription lists Counter Burst at PQ75, Dimensional Hole at PQ80, Dragon Burn at PQ82, and Absolute Zero at PQ96. It is an older community transcription, so it is used as corroboration rather than sole proof of current reward-slot semantics.
